FINGERPRINT_STATE_SPECTRUM.rule: May rank frozen representation/certificate-language candidates; cannot certify, prune, merge, or change exact state.

M2R_EXACT_RETRIEVAL.rule: Reuse requires exact semantic node key, matching capability digest and verifier replay. Similarity is advisory only.

SPIDER_TWO_LAYER_GRAPH.rule: Associative evidence graph remains advisory; exact content-addressed proof DAG alone carries state-changing semantic edges.

PIPPI_PLATEAU_LANGUAGE_SWITCH.rule: Paid plateau plus nonshrinking interface may propose a next-epoch language switch only. Same-episode authority changes are forbidden.

KEYMASTER_LANGUAGE_SELECTOR.rule: Ranks frozen certificate/projection portfolio from prior-epoch paid features; complete exact scope remains available as COLD_FULL fallback.

OPEN_FRONTIER_WITNESS.rule: Every OPEN stores exact frontier node IDs, message-language-aware interface profile, capability digest, paid ledger and immutable status.

composition_rule: Cross-language composition requires a replayable exact boundary consistency certificate. Independent parallel solvers are not composition.
mad_lab_release: BLOCKED until executable core self-tests cover all restored rules.
